verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's docs directly describe tracking spend for keys, users, and teams across 100+ LLMs, tagging spend by tag, setting personal/team budgets, and virtual keys with cost tracking, all centralized in the proxy's admin UI. This directly matches the story of tracking spend per model/key/team/user across providers in one place. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of dashboard accuracy/reporting granularity beyond vendor docs.
